edges.description: Crystal routes to the machine implementation checkpoint for structured component and boundary status, while live GitHub and CURRENT_STATE remain required for volatile truth.
CanonicalView defines Crystal's trusted read projection and its explicitly unimplemented remainder without changing TruthGate write authority.
Reader Core is the Crystal-local research architecture for source-grounded long-document reading upstream of epistemic admission.
Crystal's contradiction policy governs pending WORLD_FACT conflict review and prevents similarity, confidence, or recency from becoming an automatic epistemic winner.
The implementation manifest records which Reader Core slices exist at the dated checkpoint and which broader dedicated-runtime claims remain false.
CanonicalView deliberately reuses the contradiction policy's surface-or-abstain stance rather than silently selecting a winner between conflicting VERIFIED facts.
Titan carries a read-only observation/evaluation research contract that preserves observation, causation, evidence, policy, and authority as distinct layers.
Titan's research intake protocol classifies candidate ideas and preserves evidence-based promotion without turning external patterns into accepted architecture automatically.
The known-risks register is the active proof and governance boundary to consult after current state before claiming readiness or closure.
Titan's evaluation replay protocol supplies deterministic offline comparison and immutable evaluation receipts without controlling production routing or Canon.
Execution Observation explicitly feeds the existing immutable replay protocol instead of creating a second experiment authority or replay system.
The observation/evaluation contract exemplifies a bounded Titan-native research candidate that stays below runtime and authority promotion gates.
Native Kernel routes to project-state.json for deterministic machine gate fields while live GitHub resolves HEAD and current issue/PR lifecycle.
Native Kernel's active-risk register preserves H11 independence/admission blockers and guards against self-certification, production overclaim, and historical/current collapse.
Architecture Re-foundation records the blueprint-before-runtime program and the reference-laboratory boundary for substrate-neutral semantic obligations.
The D7 integrated re-review is preserved as historical evidence of scoped strengthening and untested residuals, not as the present H11 gate.
The current H11 false-independence blocker routes to Issue #178 for external reviewer/reproducer acquisition, which is not itself qualification or execution admission.
The provisional blueprint, independent challenge, preregistration, and BPV1 execution lineage led to the D7 scoped integrated re-review.
Soul exposes a derived machine snapshot for bounded implementation and authority flags, subordinate to live GitHub and CURRENT_STATUS on conflict.
Cognitive Orientation View is a Soul research specification for objective/history/constraint orientation without creating a goal, persistence, retrieval, or action engine.
Soul's substrate-neutral projection preserves durable semantic distinctions across replaceable implementation technologies without granting identity or runtime authority.
Soul's bounded review guide routes reviewers through current state, owning contracts, implementation, tests, and CI instead of loading the repository indiscriminately.
The research-only orientation view remains subordinate to Soul current status for engineering currentness and carries no runtime authority by itself.
The review guide explicitly sends bounded review through current engineering status before deeper contracts and historical research surfaces.
Both surfaces separate durable semantics from implementation substrate, but each keeps project-local ownership and does not transfer authority across domains.
Reader Core may preserve source-grounded observations and unresolved loops while Soul orientation reasons over bounded objectives and next-step classes; neither gains the other's authority.
Titan may observe Reader-step execution as a bounded span, while Crystal remains owner of reader artifacts and epistemic admission semantics.
